### Stress Reduction: Spreading Out the Workload
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/stress-reduction-spreading-out-the-workload1
Passage: Exodus 18:17-18
Points:
- Trying to handle every responsibility alone causes rising anxiety and physical exhaustion.
- Jethro offered objective perspective, confronting Moses with the unsustainable pace of his work.
- Wise leaders must delegate tasks to capable, God-fearing individuals of integrity.
- Handing off minor matters while focusing on key priorities protects leadership longevity.
- Facing personal stress or trials requires sharing the burden rather than persevering in isolation.

### You Don’t Have to Do it on Your Own
Author: Brent Rinehart
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/you-dont-have-to-do-it-on-your-own-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Exodus 18:17-18
Points:
- Carrying every decision and dispute alone creates overwhelming pressure and exhaustion.
- Jethro urged Moses to share the burden so both he and the people could flourish in peace.
- God created humanity to operate in community, relying on others rather than self-sufficiency.
- Pride frequently keeps individuals from asking for or accepting the help they need.
- Believers are invited to distribute their heavy loads to God and trustworthy teammates.

### A Prayer for Carrying More Than You Were Made to Carry
Author: Rachel Wojo
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-carrying-more-than-you-were-made-to-carry.html
Passage: Exodus 18:17-18
Points:
- People often confuse chronic exhaustion with faithfulness, taking on responsibilities God never assigned.
- Jethro showed Moses that attempting to meet every need alone ultimately hurts everyone involved.
- God offers an alternative between total burden-bearing and quitting: letting the community share the load.
- Asking for assistance is not an admission of failure, but an act of humility and love.
- Believers must learn to distinguish what belongs to them from what should be released.
